title: Player parleys with the goblin sentry; it answers in character without starting combat

Goblin.description: A small, vicious goblin sentry guarding the crypt stores
Goblin.personality_traits: Cowardly but vicious in a pack; greedy; wary of tall folk
Goblin.combat_style: Hits and runs; flees when outnumbered

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I lower my sword and ask the goblin what it's guarding.

actions.text: Guarding? Nuffink! Just... watching the stores, is all. Tall folk always wants the stores.
Its eyes keep flicking to the sack at its feet — something inside clinks.
